rationale: THE LOOSE HALF OF THE PACKAGE-SCOPE RULE, pinned in the flag-off state (the emission is flag-gated, so the fixture suite sees the OFF state; the ON state is pinned by script/m14/cpp-package-scope-verify.ts). THE CONVENTION IS THE POINT: the relation between a package's NAME and its include root is a CONVENTION, and it does not always hold as an equality. The namespace and the include root here are `nlohmann`, while the manifest declares the package `nlohmann_json` — so the rule needs its word-boundary-prefix half. THE CLAIM CARRIES THE MANIFEST'S OWN SPELLING (`nlohmann_json`), never the include root (`nlohmann`), so the arbiter's exact-match verification holds by construction and a claim can never refute itself: this row is the one that proves the difference matters.
